item.title: Maryland Ozempic Price Cap
item.description:
• Summary: Maryland's state affordability board has placed a price cap on Ozempic (semaglutide), a GLP-1 receptor agonist used for diabetes and weight management, in an effort to control drug costs for residents.
  • MoAs: GLP-1 receptor agonist
  • Sources: STAT News

item.description:
